t: A retired Google Linux board with a tiny AI chip for fast on-device vision.
steps: Look for a board on secondhand listings or the RS and element14 stores that still list the 4 GB version.
Get a 5 volt USB-C power supply rated for 3 amps.
Follow the official Coral get started guide to set up Mendel Linux on the board.
Connect the board to Wi-Fi or a network cable and log in from your computer.
Install the PyCoral Python library and run a sample image classification model.
Plug in a camera and try a live object detection example.
Use a separate x86 Linux computer or Colab to compile your own models for the Edge TPU.
meta: Open Board. From $105. A few stores.
